title: Repository trusted-runner git object mirror transport optimisation
purpose: Provide an optional, opt-in local git object mirror on the trusted self-hosted runner as transport acceleration only, consumed as a read-only object alternate during checkout fetch, with fail-closed event-SHA verification so the mirror can never change which commit is validated. This work is part of USF-1062 semantic-preserving optimisation and does not disturb USF-1050.

eventShaVerification.reason: actions/checkout resolves push HEAD, the pull_request auto-merge ref, and the dispatched ref to the GitHub event SHA; verifying HEAD equals GITHUB_SHA fails closed if any mirror or checkout anomaly diverges from the event SHA.

mirrorLocationSafety.rationale: A configured object alternate must live on durable host storage that the runner workspace and runner temp cleanup lifecycle never removes, so it cannot be deleted mid-run. The priming workflow step fails closed (exit 1) before exporting GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES if the configured path is not absolute or resolves under the cleanup-controlled GITHUB_WORKSPACE or RUNNER_TEMP roots. The mirror remains opt-in and inert when the variable is unset; runner-local state is never authority.

timingEvidence.reason: Exact mirror-backed checkout durations are runner-operational observations recorded in the pull request or GitHub step summary, not committed to source, consistent with the timing fixed-point policy.

relationToUsf1037: Extends the existing bounded checkout scope (candidate A and branchProtectionMap.checkoutFetchScope) as an additive, opt-in transport accelerator. It does not mutate the USF-1037 A to M candidate matrix and does not weaken any USF-OPT-CI rule.
isolationFromUsf1050: Implemented only on the USF-1062 optimisation branch. It does not modify, rebase, push to, close, merge, or supersede any USF-1050 branch, PR, worktree, issue, evidence, or in-progress file set.
